title: Build rotary position embeddings
brief: Write the cosine and sine tables, rotate queries and keys with them, and check that the score depends only on the offset.
hints: The speeds are theta ** (-2 * np.arange(d // 2) / d). The angle table is the outer product of np.arange(T) with the speeds, shape (T, d/2).
Concatenate np.cos(angles) with itself along the last axis, so each speed appears in both halves and the table has shape (T, d).
rotate_half(x) is np.concatenate([-x[..., half:], x[..., :half]], axis=-1), and apply_rope returns x * cos + rotate_half(x) * sin.
rope_score builds tables with T = max(m, n) + 1 rows, rotates q with row m and k with row n, then takes the dot product.
